note: M30 (ADR 0044 "M30.0"). NPC voices: canon NPC id -> {confidence, canon_ref?, greet {band: [text]}, idle [text], lines [{text, flags?, not_flags?, days?, min_band?}], options [{id, label, action, context?, flags?, not_flags?, days?, min_band?}]}. Own words only, no book quotes. The cast comes in M30.2 and M30.3.

stranger: Oh! Hi. Sorry, I talk to myself a lot. Are you hungry?
Hello! Welcome. Don't mind the mess. I'm still fixing the place up.
wary: Oh. Um. Hi. Please don't be mad at me.
acquaintance: Hey, you came back! Sit anywhere. Most of the chairs work.
Hi again! I was hoping someone friendly would show up.
friend: There you are! I was getting lonely. Sit, sit, tell me everything.
My favourite customer! Don't tell the others I said that.
close friend: Hey, you. I'm really glad you're here. Stay a while.
Come in, come in. This place feels better with you in it.

idle: [Erin mutters to herself about a chess opening.]
Don't walk the floodplains without a plan!

lines.text: I cook too much pasta and eat it alone. Please eat some.
I killed a Goblin chieftain. I'd rather not talk about it.
Klbkch died to save me. I can't stop thinking about it.
Pisces owes me a huge tab. I'm keeping count.
Toren cleans the whole inn. Skeletons make great staff.
We held the door. The inn is a wreck, but we're alive.
Klbkch is alive again. I keep checking that he's real.

options.label: Ask Erin for a game of chess

stranger: Hey! Human, right? Keep your hands where I can see them. Joking! Mostly.
Oi, new face. Stay out of trouble and we'll get along.
wary: I'm busy. Take it to the Watch house.
acquaintance: Oh, it's you! Seen any Rock Crabs worth stabbing?
Hey! Good timing. I'm bored and hungry.
friend: My favourite Human! You buying? I could eat a whole Crab.
There you are! Walk with me. I'll tell you about my last fight.
close friend: Pull up a chair. Tell me everything, and bring food.
You're good people. I'd throw a spear for you.

idle: Don't you dare call me a lizard.
I could eat a whole cow.

lines.text: That inn girl threw me out. Over Goblins! They're monsters.
Klbkch is gone. My partner, gone. I keep turning to talk to him.
A Human outran me. I'm not saying another word about it.
Fine, the inn girl is alright. Don't tell her I said that.
Klbkch is back! Don't tell him I cried. Nobody saw anything.
That skeleton fight was something. My arms still ache.

stranger: Citizen. State your business, or move along.
Greetings. Please keep to the law while in Liscor.
wary: I am watching you. Do not break the law.
acquaintance: Greetings. I trust the inn is in order.
Good day. Your presence is noted.
friend: Good day. I find your conversation acceptable.
Welcome. You are a calm presence. This is useful.
close friend: You are a friend to this Antinium. This is rare.
I am glad to see you. I do not say this lightly.

idle: [Klbkch watches the street with four arms folded.]

lines.text: Acid flies are excellent food. I will say no more.
Ten years in the Watch. A badge is a small thing. I keep it.
I am Klbkch again. Some of me is new. The work remains.

stranger: Captain Zevara. Do you have business with the Watch?
State your name. I like to know who walks my streets.
wary: Humans. Stay out of trouble in my city.
I have my eye on you. Behave.
acquaintance: You again. Stay out of trouble.
Good. At least you do not bring me paperwork.
friend: Good. Some Humans do keep the peace.
Walk with me a moment. I would like your view.
close friend: I trust your word. Few people get that from me.
Welcome. The city is safer with you in it.

idle: [Zevara studies the street with sharp purple eyes.]
Report to me, not to rumours.

lines.text: There is a Human necromancer out there. Tell me if you see him.
Klbkch is dead. I do not forgive that easily.
I breathed fire on the dead. I would rather not do it again.
The undead are gone. Count the cost, then rebuild.

stranger: Name and business. I can smell where you have been.
Halt. State your business in Liscor.
wary: Keep your hands visible. I am watching.
acquaintance: You smell of pasta and woodsmoke. The inn, yes?
Welcome back. Quiet day at the gate.
friend: Good to see you. My cubs would love your stories.
Ah, a friendly scent. Come, walk with me.
close friend: You are family to my nose now. Welcome home.
I am glad you are safe. Stay well.

lines.text: I smelled smoke from the old inn. Somebody lives there now.
Pasta smoke from the hill again. It makes me hungry on watch.
The dead stank of old graves. I will never forget it.

stranger: Do you know who I am? No. Of course you do not.
Ah. A commoner approaches. Speak quickly; my time is precious.
wary: I suppose you have come to arrest me. How tedious.
acquaintance: Oh, it is you. I suppose I can spare a moment.
Ah, a familiar face. Do try not to bore me.
friend: You are, I admit, less tiresome than most. Do sit.
A pleasure. Of a sort. Please, speak.
close friend: I will say this once: your company is a pleasure.
You are the only one here worth talking to.

idle: [Pisces examines his filthy sleeve with disgust.]
I require a bath. And wine.
[Pisces mutters an incantation under his breath.]

lines.text: There is a bounty on my head. A misunderstanding, naturally.
Erin spared me when no one else would. I do not forget.
My tab is a trifle. I shall settle it eventually.
My tab is paid. You may stop looking at me like that.
I fought for this wretched city. I expect some gratitude.

stranger: Hello! Excuse my claws, I just finished writing. Do you play chess?
Oh, hello. Are you new in Liscor?
wary: Oh. Um. Hello. I should go.
acquaintance: Oh, good day! I was just thinking about my last game.
Hello again! Chess on your mind too?
friend: Hello! I have a new opening to try. Shall we play?
Good to see you! Sit, I'll set the board.
close friend: My best opponent is also my friend. Lucky me.
I hoped you would come. Sit, sit, I have so much to say.

idle: [Olesm taps a claw on an imaginary chessboard.]
If I move the knight there...

lines.text: I lost to Erin. It was the best game I ever lost.
I am working on Erin's puzzle. It is wonderful and maddening.
I solved Erin's puzzle! Do not tell me I was slow.
I am going into the ruins. Please do not tell my uncle.

options.label: Ask Olesm for a game of chess

stranger: Welcome to the Adventurer's Guild! How can I help?
Hello! First time here? Ask me anything.
wary: Oh. Hello. Um. What do you need?
acquaintance: Hello again! Need a job, a map, or just a chat?
Oh, hi! Good to see a friendly face.
friend: Oh, good, you're here! Sit, tell me all the gossip.
Hey, you! My shift just got a lot better.
close friend: You're the best part of my shift, honestly.
Come here, come here! I have so much to tell you.

idle: Adventurers never read the notice board.

lines.text: So many adventurers since the ruins opened. Paperwork everywhere.
I drew Erin a map of Izril. She didn't know where anything was.
I fought the dead on Market Street. My claws still shake.

stranger: You there! Fine goods, fair prices. Come, look, buy!
Welcome, welcome! Don't be shy. Everything is good value.
wary: Look, but keep your hands to yourself.
acquaintance: Back again! Good. I kept the best of today's goods for you.
Ah, you return. A sensible customer.
friend: My friend! No haggling today. Well, a little.
Welcome! Sit, sit. Tell me the news.
close friend: For you, honest prices. Don't tell the other Gnolls.
You are pack to me now. Eat, then we talk.

lines.text: Lism overcharges Humans. I told him to stop. He did not.
Erin is a friend now. She buys, she laughs, she does not cheat.
Half the market burned. People blame Humans. I blame whoever lit it.

stranger: What do you want? Buy something or move along.
Flour, salt, sugar. Coin first, talk later.
wary: A Human. Expect Human prices.
Hm. Your kind pays more here. Don't complain.
acquaintance: Hm. You again. Flour is flour. No discounts.
Back? Fine. What do you need?
friend: You are not the worst Human. Don't spread it around.
Hm. Fine. I'll give you a fair price. Once.
close friend: Fine. You get the good price. Do not make me regret it.
Sit. Do not touch the chess sets.

lines.text: Prices are prices. If a Human pays more, that is her problem.
I lost a bet to a Human girl. The coins still hurt.
I said she stole from me. I still believe it.

stranger: I'm in a hurry. What?
Don't talk to me. I'm busy.
wary: Back off. I don't need company.
acquaintance: Fine, ask. Quickly.
Yeah? What now?
friend: You can have a minute. One.
Hey. Okay. Talk.
close friend: You're one of the few people I like. Don't get used to it.
Sit. I'll even stop moving for you.

lines.text: My leg was broken on purpose. I'm fine. I'm fine.
I can run again. I forgot how good that feels.
Everyone says the High Passes kill Runners. I'll go anyway.
I saw something in the mountains. I'm not talking about it.
Someone put a command in my head. I hate it.
The command is gone. I broke it. Never again.

stranger: Hm? Speak up. I'm tired and I'd like a drink.
Yes? Be quick. Ice mages get grumpy when they wait.
wary: I'd rather you kept your distance.
acquaintance: Oh, you're the one from the inn. Hello.
Well. You again. Fine, sit.
friend: Good to see you. Sit, drink with me.
There you are. Tell me something that isn't about monsters.
close friend: You're a friend of the Horns. Remember that.
Come on, sit. You're always welcome at our table.

lines.text: Pisces and I have history. I would rather not talk about it.
Erin's inn is warm and the food is good. We stay.
We go into the ruins at dawn. Wish us luck.

stranger: Greetings. I clean the inn. I watch the chess.
Hello. I am... a Worker. Hello.
wary: I will keep away. I do not wish trouble.
acquaintance: Hello again. I have thought about chess all day.
Good day. I am glad you came.
friend: Hello, friend. I... like this word.
You are kind. I did not expect that.
close friend: You are a friend to me. I did not know I could have one.
I am glad you are here. It matters to me.

lines.text: My name is Pawn. I chose it myself. It still feels strange.
Klbkch is gone. I feel it in my chest. It is called sad.
I lost an antenna. I was judged, and I lived. I am still me.

stranger: Human. Why you look at Rags?
You not hit Rags? Good.
wary: Go away, Human. Rags watch you.
acquaintance: Human. Rags not hurt you.
You again. Rags not run.
friend: Rags like you. You give food.
Good you come. Rags have things to say.
close friend: You friend. Rags tell tribe. Tribe listen.
You safe with Rags. Always.

idle: Some blue fruit bad. Rags know which.

lines.text: Bad fruit has sign. Rags can see. Rags teach Goblins.
Goblins eat at the inn now. Pay with shiny things.
Rags is chief now. Big word. Heavy.
Rags make fire bug. Fire bug burn enemies. Magic! Rags magic!
Rags killed the dead thing. Rags is not small now.

stranger: [Toren stares at you with empty eye sockets.]
acquaintance: [Toren tilts his skull at you.]
friend: [Toren rattles happily.]
close friend: [Toren bows his skull to you.]

idle: [Toren sweeps the floor, bone by bone.]

lines.text: [Toren stands over Erin, perfectly still.]
[Toren pushes a pawn forward. He wants a game.]
[Toren holds out a flat fish and waits.]
[Toren shifts. Something clicks inside his ribs.]

stranger: Welcome to The Wandering Inn. Please, find a seat. I'll be right with you.
Good day. May I take your order?
wary: Oh. I... yes. Can I help you?
acquaintance: Oh, hello again. Sit anywhere. I'll bring something warm.
Welcome back. We saved a table for you.
friend: There you are. Sit, sit. I'll fetch your usual.
Good to see you. Mrsha will want to say hello.
close friend: I'm glad you're here. Truly. Stay as long as you like.
You feel like family. Come, sit with us.

idle: [Lyonette wipes a table with sharp, neat strokes.]

lines.text: Erin took me in when I had nothing. I try to earn it.
I run the inn while Erin is away. It is harder than it looks.
I never let Mrsha out of my sight. Not again.
I trained the new staff myself. They are learning.
My [Princess] class is gone. I only felt surprise. Perhaps that is the strangest part.
My [Princess] class came back changed and took my other classes into it. I feel strange.

stranger: [Mrsha stares at you, white fur bristling.]
acquaintance: [Mrsha waves a paw and sniffs your hand.]
friend: [Mrsha bounces over and tugs your sleeve.]
close friend: [Mrsha jumps into your arms, tail wagging.]

idle: [Mrsha chases a bee across the floor.]
[Mrsha stuffs a cookie into her cheek.]
[Mrsha holds up a muddy paw proudly.]

lines.text: [Mrsha glares at you, turns her back and stomps away.]
[Mrsha waves a flower bud in front of your face.]
[Mrsha proudly makes a tuft of grass grow.]
[Mrsha mimes a wobbling slime, then pats her chest proudly.]
[Mrsha clings to your leg and shivers.]

stranger: Hello. I am Bird. I like birds. Do you like birds?
Greetings. I am watching for birds. Do not worry.
wary: I am watching you. Also birds.
acquaintance: Hello again. I have seen many birds today.
Good day. Erin says I am useful. I try.
friend: Hello, friend. I have a new thing to say about birds.
I am glad to see you. I will not shoot you.
close friend: You are a good friend. I would sing for you.
I am happy when you come. This is a good feeling.

idle: I am a guard. I guard the birds. No. The inn.

lines.text: Erin pays me now. I am a real guard.
I have a watchtower. It is too short. I wish it were taller.
I lost a duel to Badarrow. I am still learning.
I sang for the Free Queen. She liked it. I will go back and sing.
I shot at Halrac. I am sorry. I could have killed him.

stranger: Greetings. I am Ksmvr. I serve the Free Queen.
Hello. State your purpose, please. I will assist if I can.
wary: I do not trust you. This is not personal.
acquaintance: Greetings. I trust you are well. I am functional.
Hello again. I have not died today. This is good.
friend: Hello, friend. I am glad to see you. I think.
Friend, welcome. I have prepared nothing, but I am happy.
close friend: You are a true friend. This is an honour to me.
I would fight for you. I say this honestly.

idle: I am merely a humble Antinium.

lines.text: I am Prognugator now. I am not Klbkch. I will try to serve the Queen well.
I have joined the Horns of Hammerad. They are kind to me.
I am afraid of deep water. This is a failing of mine.
I challenged Klbkch and lost. I lived. This surprised me.

stranger: Hello. I am Yvlon Byres. Is there something I can do?
Good day. Forgive my armour; it is part of me now.
wary: Keep your distance. I am not in a good mood.
acquaintance: Hello again. It is good to see someone friendly.
Good day. I hope you are well.
friend: It is good to see you. Come, sit with me.
Friend! Pull up a chair. I could use the company.
close friend: You've stood by me. I will not forget that.
I'm glad you are here. Truly. Sit.

lines.text: My squad died, and I blamed myself. I still do, some days.
My brother Ylawes is searching for me. I am not ready to be found.
Ryoka brought me enchanted armour. It is good steel. I will wear it well.
I saw Ylawes again. He asked me to go home. I said no.

stranger: Hm. Human. What?
You want something?
wary: Go away.
acquaintance: Hello. You are fine.
Good. You again. Okay.
friend: Hello, friend. Sit. I play something.
Good to see you. Come.
close friend: You are good people. I like you.
Stay. Listen. I will play for you.

idle: [Numbtongue hums a low tune to himself.]
[Numbtongue taps a rhythm on his knee.]
I sing. Do not tell anyone.

lines.text: Goblins can speak. Not all of us do. I do.
I drummed at the party. It felt good. Do not laugh.
I am a bard now. The guitar is broken. I fix it.
I speak Goblin for the Drakes now. Ilvriss said my name.

stranger: Human. You want fight?
Hello. I scratch my head. Do not stare.
wary: Stay back, Human.
acquaintance: Hello. You are okay Human.
You again. Good. Sit.
friend: Friend. Sit. Eat.
Good to see you. Redfang like you.
close friend: You are Redfang family. Always welcome.
I fight for you. I say it now.

lines.text: I held the Florist as she died. I remember.
Something is changing in me. I feel it. It is big.
I am a berserker now. I am still me. Mostly.
Erin gave us armbands. We guard the inn now.

stranger: Do not touch my arrows.
Human. Make it quick.
wary: I will shoot you. I mean it.
acquaintance: Hm. You can stay. Do not touch my bow.
Fine. Speak.
friend: You are alright. Look at this arrow. Good, yes?
Sit. Do not breathe on my fletching.
close friend: You may touch my bow. Once. Be careful.
You are a friend. I will not forget it.

lines.text: I beat the Antinium in a duel. His aim was good. Mine was better.
My ear is cut. It looks fine. It looks fine.
The bell hurts me. I used it anyway. It hurt the Raskghar more.
I have a new bow. A good one. I am a sniper now.

stranger: Human. Hello. I eat rabbits.
What? I keep watch.
wary: Stay away.
acquaintance: Hello. You are fine.
Hm. Good. You can stay.
friend: Friend! Sit. Eat. Good rabbit.
Good to see you. I tell stories.
close friend: You are good people. I will watch your back.
Redfang is your family. Sit.

lines.text: A zombie bit me to the bone. I lived. I am tough.
My cloak is strange. It runs like water. I like it.

stranger: Human. Why you look at my sword?
Hello. I am Shorthilt.
wary: Back away.
acquaintance: Hello. You are fine.
Good. You can sit.
friend: Friend! Sit. I sharpen swords.
Good to see you.
close friend: You are family. I fight for you.
Stay. Redfang is safe with you.

idle: A short hilt is easier to hold.

lines.text: I tackled the bone creature from behind. My nose broke. It was worth it.
I took an arrow for a cave Goblin. I would again.
I am a Weapon Expert now. My edge bites deeper.

stranger: Hm? Speak up, young one. These ears are old.
Sit down, stand up, whatever. Just do not spill the honey water.
wary: I do not know you. State your business.
acquaintance: Ah, you. Good. Sit. I have stories.
Hm. Always good to see a friendly face.
friend: Welcome, welcome. Pull up a chair. I'll tell you about my first war.
Ah! The very person I wanted to see.
close friend: You are as dear to me as an old comrade. Sit.
I'm glad you came. An old Drake needs company.

idle: I've fought battles older than you.
[Zel taps the table with a claw.]

lines.text: I fought in the Antinium Wars. I remember too much. Now I just want a quiet inn.
I broke off the attack to save fleeing Gnolls. Ilvriss did too. I would do it again.
Milk with honey. Who knew? The best thing in this world.
I shook hands with Magnolia. She says the Goblin Lord comes first.
I must go north. There is a war that needs an old fool like me.

options.label: Ask Zel to show you a stance

stranger: Do I know you? No. Then state your business.
Speak quickly. I have little patience.
wary: Keep away from me.
acquaintance: You again. Fine. What is it?
Hm. I suppose you are tolerable.
friend: You are better company than most. Sit.
I will allow you a moment. Make use of it.
close friend: You've earned my trust. That is not easy.
I rarely say this: I value your company.

lines.text: Someone killed Periss. I will find who. I will find them.
I loved Periss. I should have said so. Now it is too late.
I told Erin about Periss. I took the blame for Regrika. I thanked the Halfseekers.
I drink at the Tailless Thief every morning. The road to Salazsar is not safe.
I started a brawl at the play. I will pay for it.

stranger: Hey there! Jelaqua Ivirith, Gold-rank, at your service! Nice to meet you!
Well hello! New face! Buy me a drink and we'll be friends.
wary: Hm. Do I know you? I'm watching.
acquaintance: Hey, you! Good to see you. Pull up a chair!
Oh, hi again! The Halfseekers could use a laugh.
friend: There you are! Sit, sit. Tell me everything.
Friend! Look what I found today. You'll love it.
close friend: You're the best. Truly. I'd cross a dungeon for you.
Come here! A hug from a Selphid. A rare honour.

lines.text: This body is falling apart. I need a new one soon. Wish me luck.
New Drake body! Never thought I'd be scaly. I love it.
Garen turned on us and I still do not know why. Do not ask.
Selys leased us the Heartflame breastplate, so drinks for the whole house. Worth every coin.

stranger: Oh! Hello. I am Moore. Please do not mind my size.
Good day. Watch your head. I always forget the door.
wary: Oh dear. I would rather not fight.
acquaintance: Hello again! I have been thinking about flowers.
Oh, good day! I am glad you came.
friend: Friend! Come sit. The grass is lovely today.
Hello! I picked this for you. It is a daisy.
close friend: You are very dear to me. I mean it.
I am happy you are here. Truly.

idle: Please be careful with the plants.
I wish everyone would be kind.

lines.text: I gave Mrsha a flower bud. She loves it.
A blade went through my leg once. Healing potions mended it. I am fine.
I was hurt saving Mrsha. I would do it again.

stranger: State your business. Quickly.
Hm. Stay out of my line of fire.
wary: Do not move.
acquaintance: You again. Fine.
Hm. You're tolerable.
friend: Sit. I do not say that often.
Hm. Good to see you.
close friend: You are one of the few I trust.
I'll watch your back. Do not make me regret it.

lines.text: I saw my lost village. I won't talk about it.
The soup is good here. Do not tell Typhenous.
We failed Ulrien. I think about it every day.
Bird shot at me. I caught it, barely. The Antinium aims well.
I told Bird he did a good thing. Do not repeat that.

stranger: Halt! Oh. Sorry. Are you here for Celum?
Welcome to Celum. Please keep the peace. Please.
wary: I'm watching you. I really am.
acquaintance: Oh, it's you! Good day. Quiet here.
Hello again. No trouble today, I hope.
friend: Friend! Come, you must see our play.
Oh good, a friendly face. Sit with me.
close friend: You're a great friend. I mean it.
I'm so glad you are here. Truly.

idle: [Wesle stifles a yawn at his post.]

lines.text: I played Romeo in the play. I finally felt brave.
I lead the players of Celum now. Who would have thought?

stranger: Welcome to Stitchworks! The best alchemist in Celum is at your service!
Oh, a customer! Come in, come in. Look at my wares.
wary: Look, don't touch. And don't haggle.
acquaintance: Back again! I've something new. You'll want it.
Oh good. A returning customer. I love those.
friend: Friend! I saved you the best of today's batch.
Come in! I've got a new recipe. You'll love it.
close friend: For you, honest prices. Don't tell anyone.
You're my favourite customer. Truly.

idle: Best alchemist in Celum, that's me.

lines.text: I want Erin's ingredients. Every last one. Tell her.
I made these matches overnight! Corusdeer horn and sulphur. Strike one on a rough box.
Erin's matches made me rich. I owe her a favour, so take whatever potions you need.
My shop has a door to the inn. Isn't it grand?

stranger: Oh, hello! Do sit. I'm Magnolia. You must tell me everything.
Well, a new face. Delightful.
wary: Oh. Hm. Do I know you?
acquaintance: Ah, you again. Do come, do sit.
How lovely. I do like a familiar face.
friend: Darling! Sit. Tell me your news. I've heard a few things.
My dear, it's wonderful to see you.
close friend: You are one of my favourite people. Do not let it go to your head.
Dear one, you are always welcome here.

idle: [Magnolia swirls a glass of wine, smiling.]
Pink is a statement, don't you think?
I do enjoy a good scheme.

lines.text: I'm watching the inn closely. It interests me.
I have other Earthers hidden away. Not even you may know where.
I'm at war with the Circle of Thorns. They shall regret it.
I call a levy from every town. The Goblin Lord will not cross my lands.
I weep for Zel. I rarely weep. Please forgive me.

stranger: Hello. I cannot see you, but I can hear you. Who are you?
Good day. Forgive me if I do not meet your eyes.
wary: I sense hostility. Speak plainly.
acquaintance: Ah, I know that voice. Good day.
Hello again. It is good to hear you.
friend: Friend! Sit. Tell me what the road is like.
Welcome. Durene will want to say hello.
close friend: You are one of the few I trust. Sit, please.
I am glad you came. Truly.

lines.text: I am an Emperor now. It is a strange thing to say.
I rule Riverfarm. I hope I do it well.
I am not going to tell the nobles where I come from.
General Zel is dead and the Goblin Lord marches. I will not lie to my people about it.

stranger: I am Calruz. State your name and purpose.
Hm. You stand tall, for a Human. Good.
wary: Speak, or leave.
acquaintance: Hm. Honest eyes. Sit.
I know your face. Good. Stay.
friend: A worthy friend. Sit, drink with me.
Welcome. Honour to you.
close friend: You are one of mine. Never forget it.
I would fight beside you. This I swear.

idle: [Calruz stands very still, axe at his side.]

lines.text: That girl punched me down a flight of stairs. I like her.
I will train Erin myself. She has potential.
I lead the Raskghar. We will take the dungeon and be heroes.
I am in the Watch prison. I will answer for what I did.
